contentDuplicationReport.summary: Three of five content rows reuse an areas[] string (or a boss wrongly elevated to area). Everlight Dig Site, Slayer Tower, and Barrows collide place↔content. Araxxor is boss content that was also wrongly added to areas[]. Rise of the Six is the only content row that is not a bare place name — but it lacks an explicit hostPlace link.

recommendedApplyOrder: 1. Do not edit catalog.json from this audit (handoff only).
2. When applying: rename areas Araxxor → Araxyte Hive in catalog + regions.json + placeAnchors (same commit).
3. Rewrite content[] to proposed disambiguated list with hostPlace fields (schema may need optional hostPlace if not already present).
4. Expand regions.json areas to full place-first set if product surface should match catalog map pins.
5. Run placeAnchors tests + any catalog consumers.
6. Optional: add Burgh de Rott / Meiyerditch / Mort'ton as later place expansion with new anchors.
